# CredShim

> A local credential-injection proxy for developing without giving real API keys to coding agents or apps. Apps and agents hold only dummy keys; right before a request leaves for a registered destination, CredShim replaces the dummy with the real key, and it stops a dummy headed anywhere else with 403.

It sits in between as an HTTPS proxy through `HTTPS_PROXY` (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, SSE, WebSocket) or by replacing an API's base URL, and it also handles SSH keys (as an ssh-agent), AWS access keys and IAM Identity Center (SSO), and OAuth tokens. Run as a dedicated service user (the recommended setup), an agent cannot extract the real values; it can still use them within what the rules allow.

When a request fails, CredShim's response says why and which command shows more, and `credshim docs` prints these docs for the installed version without network access. If you are an agent working behind CredShim, read Coding agents first.

Each page below is the Markdown source of the HTML page with the same name ending in `.html`. Japanese versions are at the same file names under `/credshim/ja/`.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/index.md): what CredShim does, what it protects and what it does not, supported platforms, the trial setup, presets, and using it with coding agents
- [Coding agents](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/agents.md): what an agent behind CredShim holds, how to tell what happened when a request fails, and a note for AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md
- [Installing the recommended setup](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/install.md): install, update, uninstall, and migrating from existing credentials
- [Configuration](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/configuration.md): writing rules, applying changes, base URL mode, OAuth, audit log
- [AWS](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/aws.md): static access keys and IAM Identity Center (SSO)
- [SSH agent](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/ssh.md): CredShim as an ssh-agent that keeps the keys and signs only for allowed hosts and users
- [Container isolation](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/container.md): routing all agent traffic through the proxy's checks and audit
- [Troubleshooting](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/troubleshooting.md): `credshim doctor` and its checks, refused requests (`credshim-error` kinds), Go tools on macOS
- [Threat model and design principles](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/threat-model.md): what an agent can and cannot do in each setup

## Optional

- [Development](https://fujiharuka.github.io/credshim/en/development.md): definition of done, E2E tests, and the regression test map
